- "¡Un lugar increíble! El departamento es amplio, cómodo y perfecto para familias. Tiene 3 habitaciones, un baño, y un balconcito ideal para disfrutar de las tardes y noches barcelonesas 🌆. Alejandro, el anfitrión, fue *EXCELENTE*: buena comunicación, predisposición y siempre atento a nuestras necesidades 💯. La ubicación es impecable: a pocas cuadras de Plaza Cataluña, muy céntrico 🗺️. Lindísimo, limpio y cómodo. ¡Recomendadísimo!"
- good location

- This Airbnb was amazing! It looked just like the photos and had everything we needed! It was super cozy and bright! I will say it does get really hot inside, but it was relatively cold when we stayed, so it wasn’t a problem for us at all. Alejandro is an amazing host, with a veryyyyyy detailed check in/out process and you’re told exactly what to do and why you’re doing it, which I really appreciate. He was also very attentive in his communication, messaging my group leading up to and during the trip to ensure everything was going smoothly! The beds were comfy and the bathrooms were great as well. I also loved the virtual key idea, in case my group got separated we were always able to get inside. I would definitely stay in this Airbnb again!
- The stay was pretty good, with convenient location and comfortable experience. It has everything we needed at home. I wish to recommend this accommodation to every visitor exploring Barcelona.
- 非常好的公寓，我们度过了开心的几天！
- Appartement magnifique, parfaitement propre et très bien situé. Hôte attentionné et réactif. Un séjour exceptionnel du début à la fin. Je recommande vivement.

- Veldig hyggelig vertskap. Området var rolig på kveldstid, og med godt utvalg i matvarebutikker og restauranter. Kort vei til metro og praktisk tilgang til bysentrum til fots gjennom gågaten.
- This was a great place to stay while in town for a conference, we would definitely stay here again.
- 位置很好，距离圣家堂五分钟，旁边就是地铁站，一切都很方便，推荐

- Merci Alejandro pour votre accueil et votre disponibilité. Le logement est très bien situé, flexible et facilement accessible, proche du métro, des bus et de nombreux restaurants. Séjour très agréable, je recommande vivement !

- The apartment was very good and comfortable, it had everything listed on the description, and considering how big Barcelona is and how many things it has to offer, the location was good too, as most of the things were more or less 20 minutes walk. Overall it was clean, except a few things on the kitchen we found not cleaned properly. The check in went smoth and the digital key worked perfectly and very easy to use, although we had a problem at the begging because even though the digital key was supposed to be available after 15:00, it was still unavailable, but we were lucky to meet one of the hosts who helped us and forwarded the key! This only a 4 star(4.5 if I could) because of the price and what it had to offer. Considering you also have to pay the tourist tax, the overall accommodation was a little bit more expensive than what the apartment has to offer. Other than that, everything was great!

- El lugar es grande, hermoso y simplemente espectacular. La ubicación es excelente, muy cerca de varios puntos de interés de Barcelona, lo que hace la estadía aún mejor. ¡Sin duda volveríamos y lo recomendamos al 100%! ⭐️
- Great apartment. Great Host.
- 这次西班牙旅行让我和朋友的家庭旅行变得更轻松 带着小朋友入住这次选择真没错 带露台的房子让我们不出门的时光都变得惬意 离主街道很近 购物很方便 周边美食也很多 还有华人小超市 总之体验很棒 房东及管家都很棒 及时回复消息 这个厨房大吧台超级好 这一周我们都是围着它欢声笑语
- Alejandro était tres disponible et les photos correspondent bien au logement Je recommande les yeux fermés

- Great apartment! We had a great time in Barcelona, and Alejandro was always helpful and responsive. The apartment is really nice, especially on the balcony. The road outside can be loud, but it was never an issue for us. The area is very walkable, close to the Sagrada Familia, metro stations, and good restaurants and bars. Highly recommend!

- Great location, close metro station and plenty of restaurants. Walkable to most attractions. Quiet despite being centrally located. The lack of any view from the window is the the price you pay for it being quiet. Check in instructions were excellent and easy but you will need an internet connection.
- All as expected, everything went well. Thank you Alessandro!
- Stayed in this beautiful and bright and very well located apartment and loved everything about our stay.

- Location is so good, walkable distance to a lot of places, so spacious and actually bigger than the pictures show, the place is clean, host was really helpful, friendly and responsive, would definitely recommend!!!, only thing is neighbours were rude and can’t make noise past 8pm.
- Everything was great, will definately come back, if there is a chance!
- Alles hat prima geklappt. Sehr gute Kommunikation und die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und komfortabel. Vielen Dank für den guten Aufenthalt!

- je recommande chaudement ce airbnb tres bien situé dans lequel nous avons pu nous reposer après nos journées a marcher dans barcelone. nous avons très bien dormi et notre fils de 9 mois a bien dormi aussi dans le lit mis a disposition. un tres bon restaurant de poisson proche du logement : la paradeta . petit conseil aux futurs hotes : prevoyez une connexion internet sur votre téléphone. la premiete ouverture de la porte peut etre faite par télephone sans probleme mais j imagone que c est plus pratique via le lien mis a disposition

- Departamento con excelente ubicación, a pasos de la Sagrada Familia y del metro. Todo nuevo, impecable y exquisitamente decorado. El edificio cuenta con ascensor, lo cual es un plus muy valioso. El único inconveniente lo tuvimos con la cerradura electrónica ya que nos quedamos sin poder entrar dos veces, la segunda al anochecer y con las compras del supermercado. Pudimos entrar en las dos ocasiones gracias a la ayuda de otros turistas. Los anfitriones muy amables y en contacto para resolver este inconveniente. Luego nos facilitaron las llaves físicas, pudimos movernos sin ninguna dificultad, usando ambos métodos de ingreso.

- The apartment is amazing! First, it's spotless clean and has everything you need (dishwasher, hairdryer, washing machine, nespresso machine etc etc). Then, the location is fantastic, if you cross the street you're on the beach of Bogatell which I believe is the best in Barcelona, plenty of very good restaurant all around, mini-markets around the corner for every need. I also want to add that it's very well connected to the city center, the bus stop is literally in front of the apartment and gets you to Plaza Catalunya/Universitat in 30 minutes. Poble Nou is very nice for families and there are plenty of playgrounds (one between the apartment and the beach and it's great) and things to do with children. Only 10 minutes by bus and 20 walking you reach Glories with a mall that has everything and also amazing playgrounds and water fountains. Perfect for whoever wants to visit the city especially families or groups of friends.

- A beautiful apartment—spotlessly clean, fully refurbished, and more spacious than expected. From the outside and the lobby you wouldn’t expect how perfect the apartment is inside. The apartment is even better than the photos suggest. The bedrooms are extremely comfortable, making it ideal for a family stay. Blackout curtains in the bedroom and a bit more sound insulation from the street would make an already wonderful apartment even better. We would absolutely love to return and highly recommend this apartment for anyone visiting Barcelona.
- Had a great stay! The location was perfect, the apartment was very clean, and check-in was super easy. Everything was smooth from start to finish. Would happily stay here again 😊
- Great place, good apartment, I was fully happy with it.
- nice area and the flat is clean and cozy

- Alejandro’s place was perfect place for my husband and I, apartment was very spacious and spotless , metro was just around the corner many great restaurants and many coffee shops they were all very close by Alejandro sent communication every day and he was very thoughtful and very accommodating to our request We will definitely stay again if we are in Barcelona
- Alles bestens!
- Perfect stay and super helpful
- A great apartment! very clean and tidy with great facilities and easy walking distance of the centre with some lovely local little bars we had a great stay!

- Everything was a 10 from minute one! I stayed 6 nights at this apartment and the experience was excellent. The hosts have a very well-organized system that clearly shows their experience. Communication was outstanding with incredibly fast responses. All instructions regarding the accommodation were extremely clear, from check-in procedures to how to use all the appliances. The kitchen was impressively well-stocked—I had everything needed to cook both simple and complete meals without any issues. Having a dishwasher and washing machine was a huge plus. Everything was very comfortable and the location is excellent. It's super easy to get to all the main tourist spots from there. Honestly, 100% recommended!
- דירה מצויינת. נקיה, מרווחת ובסביבה טובה מאוד. כל האטרקציות במרחק הליכה ויש תחבורה ציבורית צמודה. איש הקשר היה זמין ואדיב מאוד. ממליץ מאוד על הדירה.

- We enjoyed our stay here, with just a couple caveats listed at the end. The location is great and the hosts were very responsive. The place is comfortable for a few days stay, and is in a good location with many good stores, restaurants and the metro within 5-10 min walking. You can hear some activity on the street outside, so I suppose it could be a bit noisy on weekend nights or during the touristy season (we were there in February) but it did not bother us at all. Our only major issue was the limited amount of hot water. After running out of water after a 5-6 min shower, we contacted the host thinking something was wrong. They sent someone to investigate, but turns out it's just a small tank. The water heater is 100L (26 gal), which will give you about 5min 45 sec - 6min 15 sec (we timed it every day) of shower time, then it takes 2-3 hours until you have more hot water. There is also a washing machine, but no dryer, which is apparently common in Europe but we were a bit surprised.
- 公寓位置优越，步行10分钟到圣家堂，附近超市美食都很多，房间很干净，设施齐全，房东很热情提供帮助，非常推荐
- Place was good! View from terrace is amazing and location is 10/10! Recommend!
- Großartiges Appartement mit traumhaftem Ausblick direkt auf die Sagrada Familia. Besser geht nicht!

- Alejandro's apartment was a perfect spot in central Barcelona. Lots to do, eat, shop, and experience. Everything was clean. The host team was very responsive and proactive in making sure we were set up for a very easy stay.

- Nuestra estadía en Barcelona fue muy agradable. El alojamiento resultó cómodo, luminoso y muy bien conectado, lo que nos permitió disfrutar la ciudad con total facilidad. Nos sentimos como en casa desde el primer día.

- Sehr nette & proaktive Kommunikation der Gastgeber mit Tipps und allen wichtigen Informationen, schnelle Antwort & Check-in war sehr einfach. Alles da was man braucht, das Badezimmer ist etwas klein, aber für ein paar Tage völlig in Ordnung, Lage sehr gut, nicht weit zur U-Bahn & nette Cafés in der Nähe.
- amazing

- Highly recommended apartment. It matched the images and description. The place is in a well-connected area, very comfortable to walk to the city's major attractions, and nearby there are cafes and markets. My parents enjoyed staying here very much. The apartment is very clean and equipped with everything. I would love to stay in this apartment again. The host was very attentive throughout.
- Todo perfecto, muchas gracias!!
- La pasamos muy bien en el apartamento, muy cómodo, tranquilo y muy bien ubicado. Lo recomiendo.
- Прекрасная квартира и удобное расположение! Чисто, приятно! Рекомендую!

- We really enjoyed our stay! The flat was near the subway station, yet in a calm street. Alejandro was very responsive, provided us with all the information we needed, even managed to fulfill some extra requests of ours (e.g. extra cot and highchair). The accomodation was well equipped, huge kitchen, living room, dining room, just as seen on the pictures. As we were traveling with small children, it was important to have shutter rollers, separated rooms from the living room, calm street and neighbourhood. We got all of that!

- O Airbnb é muito bem localizado, com fácil acesso a tudo, e uma zona muito calma. O espaço é bem equipado e atendeu às expectativas durante a estadia. O anfitrião foi muito prestável e atencioso, respondendo sempre com rapidez. Como pontos negativos, as janelas deixam passar bastante o barulho externo e, em dias de vento, tanto as janelas quanto a porta de entrada batem e acabam fazendo bastante ruído, o que pode incomodar um pouco. Mas no geral, correu tudo perfeitamente.

- O apartamento é muito bom com ótima localização, apenas uma ressalva para o check in, pois existe muito procedimento e ainda a porta não se abre tão simples como demonstrado no vídeo, para quem chegar à noite, se atentem a isso. De forma geral a estadia ocorreu tudo bem.

- Je recommande vivement le logement d'Alejandro ! Tout était parfait. Le logement était impeccable a notre arrivée. Alejandro est aux petits soins, avec des messages réguliers pour savoir si tout se passe bien. Le metro est a proximité et dessert toutes les principales attractions de Barcelone. Merci encore !
- 虽然不是市中心但离地铁站很近，去各个景点也很方便，街区也让人比较安心
- un logement propre et idéalement situé! les instructions et la communication étaient très claires. je recommande vivement!

- The apartment is as shown in the pictures, just a little worn off here and there but very clean and extremely well-equipped. The neighbourhood is absolutely lovely and it is a great spot to explore the city from. Alejandro was very attentive, helpful and friendly and provides guest with a nice „food-guide“, which we loved. Only downside is that the kitchen counter isn’t really usable as ants appear from little cracks as soon as any food or used kitchen ware is displayed. (Alejandro offered to take care of it immediately but we declined as we were only there a couple of days and didn’t cook.).
- Wir kommen wieder

- L'appartement est bien placé, agréable, très propre. Alejandro était réactif, l'accès à l'appartement facile et pratique. Comme indiqué dans les commentaires, il y a une chambre côté palier qui est assez bruyante, y mettre des voyageurs qui ne sont pas gênés par le bruit. Notez bien qu'il n'y a pas de lave vaisselle. Seuls bémols du voyage, un seul petit torchon à vaisselle est fourni, il n'y a pas de basique alimentaire (sel et poivre par exemple) et il n'y avait que 4 verres à vin pour un appartement prévu pour 7 personnes...c'est pas grand chose mais ça fait mauvais effet ! Très bon point : on a eu à disposition un lit bébé et un siège bébé, c'était très pratique.

- L'appartement est bien situe et la terrasse est vraiment bien, le ménage était ok a part les ustensiles de cuisine qui étaient vraiment sales. Les meubles sont vieux (canape défraîchit, bureau chambre principale avec des trous dans le bois. Ils ont un système pour mesurer le bruit, alors que l'on regardait la Tv avec un volume vraiment normal on a reçu une alerte nous disant de réduire le bruit au plus vite, un peu autoritaire. Un appel pour le demander aimablement et s'assurer que c'était le cas aurait été plus sympathique. Le bien est cher pour sa qualité, et la saleté des ustensiles est inacceptable, les poêles et casseroles sont piquées. Rentabilité maximum, service minimum. Nous ne répéterons pas.
- El departamento es hermoso! Está cuidado cada detalle, es cómodo y muy cálido! Estuvimos muy a gusto! Sin duda volveríamos!
- Polecam. Świetna lokalizacja - w pobliżu sklepy i restauracje. Z ulicy dochodziły hałasy ale nie były uciążliwe.
- Alejandro is a great host and the apartment was perfect for our trip
- Polecam serdecznie!

- We loved our stay, it was perfect. The location was perfect! We stayed with our daughter, the host provided us a comfortable crib and had a small bath we could also use. Would go back

- We had a wonderful stay at this spacious 3-bedroom apartment in Sarrià. The neighborhood is charming and peaceful, a nice escape from the busy tourist crowds, yet well-connected by public transport . The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had all the amenities we needed for our family. We especially loved the local cafes and bakeries just a short walk away. Highly recommended for a relaxing stay in Barcelona!
- Really good hosts. Would totally stay here again. Close to The sangrada familia and other transportations.

- El departamento es muy amplio. Está muy bien ubicado. Está en una calle bastante transitada, pero aún así es muy silencioso para dormir. Somos una familia de cuatro personas, y el agua caliente no alcanza para cuatro duchas. Hay que ser muy medido o esperar un largo tiempo hasta que el agua vuelva a calentarse.
- tutto perfetto,altamente consigliato!!!
- Mooi appartement in een levendige buurt.

- Barcelona seyahatimizde bu evde konaklamaktan gerçekten çok memnun kaldık. Konumu harikaydı; şehrin pek çok önemli noktasına yürüyerek rahatça ulaşabildik ve toplu taşımaya neredeyse hiç ihtiyaç duymadık. Aynı zamanda oldukça nezih ve güvenli bir semtte yer alması hem akşam geç saatlerde dönüşlerde hem de günlük planlarımızda bize büyük rahatlık sağladı. Dört yetişkin ve iki genç olarak konakladık ve ev bizim için fazlasıyla yeterliydi. Odaların kullanışlılığı, yaşam alanının ferahlığı ve düzeni sayesinde kalabalık hissetmedik. Hem birlikte vakit geçirebileceğimiz alanlar vardı hem de isteyenin kendi alanına çekilebileceği bir düzen sunuyordu. Ev temiz, bakımlı ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibiyle iletişim son derece kolay ve hızlıydı. Tüm sorularımıza kısa sürede yanıt verdi ve giriş öncesinde gönderdiği detaylı talimatlar sayesinde eve sorunsuz şekilde ulaşıp yerleşebildik. Bu özellikle şehir dışından gelen misafirler için büyük konfor sağlıyor. Genel olarak konum, kon
- Excelente todo
- Minden rendben volt, az apartman olyan mint a képeken. A szállásadó rendkívül kedves és segítőkész volt mindenben.
- Aangenaam verblijf gehad.
- Långsamt wifi måste använda mobildata. Vi kom ganska sent och värden brukar lämna vatten i lägenheten men här fanns inget.

- Läget på lägenheten var toppen, gångavstånd till både sevärdheter och bra restauranger och barer. Om vi åker tillbaka till Barcelona kommer vi hyra här igen. //Gunnar

- My friends and I had a blast staying in this place. It was right next to Sagrada Família, surrounded by coffee shops and restaurants, the metro station and the bus stop within walking distance. It really was a great experience and an excellent starting point to explore all of Barcelona.
- Alejandro was very helpful and a great host. Highly recommend

- Alles war super in der Unterkunft – sei es die Beschreibung vor der Ankunft, die Funktion mit dem elektronischen Schlüssel, die Umgebung oder das Airbnb selbst. Es war groß genug für acht Personen und wir waren insgesamt mit allem sehr zufrieden. Die einzige Kleinigkeit, die ich erwähnen kann, betrifft ein Zimmer: Dort gab es abends, nachts und auch morgens immer wieder ein Geräusch. Wir wissen leider nicht, woher es kam. Es klang ein bisschen wie ein Ventilator, teilweise aber auch so, als würde jemand bohren. Wir haben Alejandro direkt kontaktiert, und er war super freundlich und hat sofort geantwortet. Auch er wusste nicht, woher das Geräusch kam, da so etwas zuvor noch nie vorgekommen ist. Für die Person, die in diesem Zimmer geschlafen hat, war es natürlich etwas unangenehm und der Schlaf dadurch etwas unruhig. Diejenigen mussten nachts Ohrstöpsel benutzen. Abgesehen davon war wirklich alles top. Ich kann die Unterkunft von Herzen weiterempfehlen.
- Appartamento grande e molto pulito, unica pecca un po’ distante dalla rambla ma comunque facilmente raggiungibile con la metro

- The apartment was okay, located almost in the city center. The apartment has all the needed amenities, but the water heater is too small for 4 people, max for 2. We booked the apartment in early March when the weather is still a bot frizzy. One of the room heaters didn’t work. The owner is pleasant and always glad to help.

- Spatious apartment, very clean, in a beautiful spot in the city with newer and good buildings. Half an hour walk to the places you usually want to see but it’s a nice walk. The view from the balcony is very beautitul. We were a group of 6, and had everything we needed- 1.5 bathrooms, equiped kitchen and enough space to eat and sleep. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with. The only thing I didn’t like is that we had to pay tourist tax separately from the price here on AirBnB. Other than that, worth the money and would definetely recommend.
- Good stay, everything was as described.

- Το διαμέρισμα είναι ευρύχωρο και καλά εξοπλισμένο και η διαμονή 4 ενηλίκων ήταν άνετη. Η περιοχή είναι ιδιαίτερα βολική και υπάρχουν αρκετές επιλογές σε εστιατόρια και καφέ. Ο χώρος ήταν καθαρός, όπως και τα σεντόνια. Το μόνο πρόβλημα που επισημαίνω είναι η κατάσταση του καναπέ - θέλει άμεση αντικατάσταση. Είναι αδύνατον να καθίσεις. Επίσης το πάτωμα της καμπίνας του ντους είναι ιδιαίτερα ολισθηρό όταν βραχεί. Ο Alejandro και η ομάδα του ανταποκρίθηκε άμεσα σε κάθε ερώτησή μου. Και ειδικά στο θέμα της ντουσιέρας, προθυμοποιήθηκε να μου φέρει αντιολισθητικό αξεσουάρ, αμέσως μόλις τον ενημέρωσα.

- We had an absolutely wonderful stay. The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and helpful from start to finish — always quick to answer questions and provide guidance whenever we needed it. The apartment itself was fantastic: spotless, comfortable, secure, and beautifully maintained. Everything felt very clean and well cared for. The beds were comfortable, the layout worked perfectly for our family, and we truly appreciated how peaceful and safe the space felt. The terraces were a highlight — such a special feature and a lovely place to relax. The location couldn’t have been better. It’s very walkable, with great restaurants, shops, and essentials nearby, and the metro access made getting anywhere in the city incredibly easy. It was nice coming back to a quieter neighborhood after a day in busier parts of the city. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Barcelona!

There are greengrocers, bakeries, tapas bars, michelin star restaurants, but also lovely bars and a nice breakfast cafe around the corner from the flat. I recommend La petit, a lovely, small tapas bar literally next to the flat, with excellent food and drinks. Excellent for a lazy evening if you aren't keen on walking. Big thanks to Alejandro for his hospitality, I thoroughly recommend the flat.

Großartige Unterkunft mit viel Platz, perfekter Ausstattung und sehr nettem Gastgeber. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ - Wir hatten einen wirklich ausgezeichneten Aufenthalt und können diese Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen. Das Apartment ist sehr sauber, modern und äußerst geräumig. Die Zimmer sind groß und komfortabel, und besonders praktisch fanden wir, dass zwei Schlafzimmer jeweils über ein eigenes Badezimmer mit Toilette verfügen. Das war für unsere Familie ein großer Vorteil. Die Küche ist hervorragend ausgestattet und bietet alles, was man für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt benötigt. Auch die Klimaanlage hat an den heißen Tagen in Barcelona perfekt funktioniert. Das WLAN war schnell und stabil, sodass es ebenfalls nichts zu beanstanden gab. Der große Esstisch für bis zu acht Personen war ideal für gemeinsame Mahlzeiten. Der Gastgeber war sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und die Kommunikation verlief jederzeit schnell und unkompliziert. Wir haben uns während unseres gesamten Aufenthalts sehr wohlgefühlt. Der einzige kleine Nachteil ist, dass keine Parkplätze zur Unterkunft gehören. Wer mit dem Auto anreist, sollte beachten, dass Parken in der Innenstadt von Barcelona teuer sein kann. Wir haben für drei Tage insgesamt etwa 90 € für ein Parkhaus bezahlt. Davon abgesehen war alles hervorragend. Wir würden diese Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen und freuen uns schon auf unseren nächsten Aufenthalt. Vielen Dank für die tolle Gastfreundschaft! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Das Parken in der Innenstadt war sehr schwierig
